reason: We already pay a yearly AMC to our ERP vendor and years of fee and student data sit there, so I am not moving the whole school to a new name I saw online. The exam-centre module does touch a real headache for me in board season, but I would not pay for it this month; at most I might try the free trial before the next board exams.
objection: It's a new company with no schools I know using it. If it fails in the middle of board exams or the company shuts down, I'm the one answering to CBSE and the principal, and we would still be paying our old vendor for everything else.
would_change_my_mind: Another CBSE exam-centre school nearby that ran a full board exam season on the exam-centre module without trouble, so I could buy only that module for about Rs 5,000 to 8,000 alongside our current ERP.
